memory:
User shoots portraits, street/travel, landscapes and low light with Nikon D5600, manual focus. Enjoys new 70–200mm zoom; also has a satisfying 50mm prime. 18–55mm kit lens has focusing issues. Considering Nikon Z6 or Canon EOS R; sturdy full-frame-ready tripod to replace worn Manfrotto BeFree; Gitzo

REMINDERS (from a consistency check against the session):
- Remote flash triggers/shutter releases obtained through a workshop are omitted.
- Camera-bag options are omitted: Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW and Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L.
- The user’s initial lean toward the Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L is omitted; no purchase was confirmed.
- Other tripod options are omitted: Manfrotto MT057CXPRO4 and Really Right Stuff; Gitzo is retained.
- The possible ND-filter purchase is omitted.
- The possible 14–24mm or 16–35mm wide-angle lens purchase is omitted.
- The 70–200mm was successfully used for portraits and at a local park; that usage is omitted.
- “Full-frame-ready” is added as a tripod requirement, but R only states the desired tripod should be sturdy.
